verdict.rationale: Thoropass's Risk Register offers a 4x4/5x5 scored risk configuration, links risks to controls and action items, supports role-based risk management, and enables ongoing review/mitigation in-platform (thoropass-docs-10, thoropass-docs-7, thoropass-docs-33, thoropass-docs-36, thoropass-docs-65). However, evidence does not clearly document formal treatment-plan workflows, explicit risk scoring methodology detail, or dedicated review-cycle scheduling/reminders tied specifically to risks (review cycle evidence found is for access reviews, not risk register reviews). missing for 10: explicit treatment-plan/remediation workflow tied to risks, documented risk review cadence/scheduling mechanics, and independent/hands-on corroboration of scoring and owner accountability in practice.
